General Medicine Physician

Dra. María Fernanda Ocampo Mora

CGCOM | 291409735Spanish

Dr. María Fernanda Ocampo Mora, MD Emergency Medicine | Aesthetic Medicine | General and Family Medicine Dr. María Fernanda Ocampo Mora is a highly qualified physician with extensive experience in emergency medicine, general and family medicine, and aesthetic medicine. She graduated as a physician from Universidad Libre de Cali and has developed a strong clinical track record in hospital, emergency, intensive care, and private settings. Dr. Ocampo has worked in high-complexity hospitals in Spain, such as Hospital Quirón Málaga and Hospital Quirón Marbella, providing emergency medical care, rapid diagnosis, and multidisciplinary care to patients in critical situations. In addition, she brings strong international experience in Colombia, where she worked for several years in intensive care units (ICU) and emergency services, treating critically ill patients and complex medical cases. Alongside her practice in emergency care and hospitals, Dr. Ocampo has developed extensive experience in Aesthetic Medicine, currently practicing in private clinics such as Clínica IOX Marbella and Clínica Vasari. She holds a Master’s in Aesthetic Medicine and a Master’s in Facial Treatments, with certified European academic training. Her aesthetic practice focuses on minimally invasive procedures, facial and body treatments, patient safety, and personalized treatment protocols, aligned with the highest medical standards. Dr. Ocampo combines clinical precision with a strong preventive and holistic approach to patient care. She is an expert in emergency diagnosis, preventive medicine, public health principles, and advanced aesthetic techniques, always prioritizing patient safety, ethics, and continuous professional development. Known for her professionalism, empathy, and clinical judgment, Dr. Ocampo is committed to providing high-quality medical care that promotes health and well-being. She offers consultations in Spanish.

The doctor you book is the doctor you see.

Questions

FAQs

How do I choose the right doctor?

Browse doctor profiles by specialty, language and available appointment times to find the best match for your needs, or book directly with the next available doctor.

How do I know a doctor is properly qualified?

Each profile shows the doctor's registration details. All doctors on Global Health are registered with Organización Médica Colegial (colegios de médicos).

Can I choose a doctor by language?

Yes. Consultations are available in multiple languages, subject to clinician availability, and you can filter or select a doctor by language when booking.

How do I book with a specific doctor?

Open the doctor's profile and select an available appointment time to book directly with them.

Can I see the same doctor for a follow-up?

Yes. You can book a follow-up appointment with the same doctor, subject to their availability.

Medical disclaimer

All medical services provided through Global Health are delivered by doctors registered with Organización Médica Colegial (colegios de médicos).

Our online doctors conduct remote clinical assessments and may provide treatment recommendations, referrals, or medical certificates only where clinically appropriate and at the treating doctor's professional discretion. Clinical decisions remain entirely at the doctor's discretion following assessment.

Our doctors do not routinely prescribe controlled substances through online consultations.

Online consultations are not suitable for medical emergencies. If you are experiencing a medical emergency, please contact emergency services immediately by calling 112 or attend your nearest emergency department.
